about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file.

playbook.notes: Mutant Menace (The Wise Mothman, BUG counters and rad/mill). Written from 12 stock goldfish games (seeds 23001-23012): stock kills on turn 11.3, casts Mothman on own turn 4 to 11 (median 5), never cast Bloatfly Swarm, Raul, Feral Ghoul, Struggle for Project Purity, Guardian Project or Contaminated Drink, and under-cast its ramp (Cultivate 1 of 5, Talisman of Dominance 1 of 5) and the counter doublers (Winding Constrictor, Hardened Scales held with the mana up). Rule 1: ramp first. Rule 2: the commander as soon as it can be cast (each mill of a nonland card of ours then grows the team). Rule 3: the counter doublers next, before the creatures they multiply. Rule 4: the engines (Raul, Hancock, Guardian Project, Inexorable Tide, Marcus, Scorchbeast, Mirelurk Queen). Rule 5: tap Raul in the first main phase so every player mills one before combat (Mothman, Mirelurk and Scorchbeast trigger on our own nonland mills), library 30 or more. Rule 6: the rest of the creatures, dearest first, whatever Forge thinks of them (Bloatfly Swarm was never cast by stock). Rule 7: Vault 87 and Struggle for Project Purity with 45 cards or more in the library (both draw). Rule 8: Biomass Mutation (AI:RemoveDeck:All) before combat at X 6 or more with three attackers. Rule 9: Contaminated Drink at X 3 or more with a short hand and a deep library. Rule 10: Harmonize. Rules 11-12: Strength Bobblehead's counters and Contagion Clasp's proliferate as after-combat mana sinks. Triggers: Scorchbeast's tokens and Radroach's return always; Tato Farmer's two rad counters on us only while Mothman or Scorchbeast turns our own mills into counters or tokens, with 50 cards left and 20 life. Answers (Putrefy, Atomize, Casualties of War, Nuclear Fallout, Find // Finality, Alpha Deathclaw's monstrosity, Rampaging Yao Guai, Mutational Advantage) are left to Forge for a second pass. || Version 2 (answers, written from the 200 tables of bots of ab-run #27, seed 20261260: the candidate won 55, stock 46). At the seat's losses the biggest opposing board held 12.5 creatures on average against our 3.8 (131 of 145 losses: more than ours; 111: six or more), and the seat died within a turn cycle from 19 life; Nuclear Fallout was in hand at 37 losses and cast in none of 52 games (stock: 0 of 45; Forge never casts it), Find // Finality 0 of 41. New rules 1-3, above everything, first main phase: Nuclear Fallout at X 3 (each creature -6/-6) when the strongest opposing board has more power than ours and four or more creatures; Nuclear Fallout at X 2 (-4/-4, kills tokens, spares our creatures with counters) when one opponent has six or more creatures and more than we do; Find // Finality on the same terms (Finality; whether the split card's Find half is taken instead is Forge's ordering, checked at the local tables). Rule 7 (after ramp, commander, doublers): Casualties of War, Alpha Deathclaw, Atomize when an opponent has a creature; targets and modes are Forge's (Casualties is cast only when Forge's logic agrees; Deathclaw is a plain creature cast and its enters trigger is aimed by Forge). Stock cast Deathclaw in 41 of 48 games and Casualties in 32 of 37; the engine rules starved both (10 of 51, 17 of 30). Rule 8: Vault 87 out of the old rule 7, with library 30 (was 45) and an opposing creature (chapter I steals a non-Mutant creature; chapter III draws by the greatest Mutant power). Rule 11: The Master's tap after Raul's mill in the first main phase (Forge aims it at a creature card milled this turn). Rule 12: Rampaging Yao Guai at X max, at least 3 (its artifact/enchantment destruction is Forge's choice). Rule 13 (the old rule 6) now names every creature and permanent the base left to Forge, which the play rules starved of mana: Lumbering Megasloth first (castable only when its counter discount makes it cheap), Nightkin Ambusher, The Master, Harold and Bob, Fraying Sanity, Power Fist. Stock cast them in 82 to 98% of the games drawn; the base in 17 to 60%. Rule 14: Struggle for Project Purity alone with library 45, as before. Rule 16: Mutational Advantage before combat with four attackers and three opposing creatures (our creatures with counters cannot be killed in that combat; then proliferate): the format cannot hold it for a wipe on another player's turn, and in hand it was cast in 1 of 38 games and held at 28 losses. Alpha Deathclaw's monstrosity is left to Forge: an activate rule cannot tell that the creature is already monstrous and would pay seven mana a turn for nothing.
